title: Sunday · the Sound at dawn
logline: The arc's first Sunday: Puget Sound at dawn from the pavilion's dock, the islands, the far lights of Vancouver Island going out. No one on the dock yet. The place a week before the night it matters.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the Sound at dawn from the dock's end, islands layered in pale cerulean and linen, the far lights of Vancouver Island fading as the sky comes up.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in pale cerulean and linen, Puget Sound at dawn from a dock with layered islands and a few distant lights going out, no figures, no words

panels.name: Dawn

panels.composition: Tier 2: the dock's cedar planks, wet, empty, one heron at the end. The pavilion's glass behind, dark, reflecting the water.

image.prompt: watercolor, wet cedar dock planks with a heron at the end and a dark glass pavilion behind reflecting the water, no words
image.notes: The dock of dw_2014-07-27, a week early, with nobody on it.

panels.name: The dock, empty

panels.composition: Tier 3: the water. The light coming across it. Held.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor of calm sound water with dawn light coming across it, no words

panels.name: Light

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: The dock, a week early, empty.
